**Why the impairment:** In Q3 2023 PLNL entered into a new gas sales contract with NGC (effective October 2023 through December 2025). Because of the terms of that contract, CF assessed its PLNL investment and found its carrying value exceeded fair value. It recorded a $43 million impairment [3].

**Remaining risk:** If NGC does not make enough natural gas available to PLNL at prices that permit profitable operations, PLNL may cease operating its facility, and CF would write off the remaining investment. The carrying value at December 31, 2023 was $26 million [3]. NGC's commitment to supply gas beyond December 2025 depends on new agreements [3].
